title: Surabaya Marathon 2026 Review: What the Comeback Edition Was Like
seo_title: Surabaya Marathon 2026 Review | Surabaya, East Java
meta_description: Surabaya Marathon 2026 review: almost 8,000 runners on 2 August as the race returned after seven years, a flat city route and cultural shows on the course.
dek: Surabaya's marathon came back on 2 August 2026 after seven years away, with almost 8,000 runners. Here is what the comeback edition was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: The Surabaya Marathon is back, and on the evidence of 2026 it came back well. First run in 2017 and last held in 2019 before the pandemic, it returned on Sunday 2 August 2026 with almost 8,000 runners from Indonesia and abroad [1][2]. The route runs flat through the city centre from Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya, past the city's landmarks, with East Javanese cultural performances along the way [1][2]. Robi Siyanturi won the marathon [1]. If you want a big, flat city marathon in Java, this is a promising choice.

sections.heading: A Comeback After Seven Years
paragraphs: The Surabaya Marathon was first held in 2017 and ran again in 2018 and 2019 before it was put on hold during the pandemic [1]. The 2026 race, backed by the shopping-centre association APPBI, was its first in seven years [1].
Almost 8,000 runners took part, from across Indonesia and several other countries, in the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km [1][2]. There were open, national and masters divisions [1].

sections.heading: The Route and the Atmosphere
paragraphs: The race started and finished at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya and ran through the city centre [1]. A 10 km runner from Jakarta, running in Surabaya for the first time, praised the route as flat and passing many of the city's landmarks [2].

At several points runners were greeted by East Javanese cultural shows, including kuda lumping dancers and fire performances, alongside cheer squads [1]. The organisers worked with the police, the transport department and marshals to reopen the main roads quickly [1].

sections.heading: Race Pack and Results
paragraphs: Race-pack collection ran over two days, 31 July and 1 August, at Tunjungan Plaza 6, with a health talk programme on the first day covering preparation, injuries and running safely [1]. About 2,000 runners collected their packs by 5pm on the first day [1].
Robi Siyanturi won the full marathon [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a flat city marathon in Java with a big field, yes. The comeback edition drew almost 8,000 runners, and runners liked the route.
It is still an early edition of a revived race, so watch how the organisers build on 2026. The fundamentals, a flat route, cultural support on the roads and good traffic management, were there.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition, including a runner's comments. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: When did the Surabaya Marathon return?
faqs.answer: On Sunday 2 August 2026, after seven years away. The race was first held in 2017 and ran again in 2018 and 2019 before it was put on hold during the pandemic. The 2026 comeback drew almost 8,000 runners.

faqs.question: What is the Surabaya Marathon route like?
faqs.answer: Flat and central. In 2026 it started and finished at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya and ran past many of the city's landmarks, with East Javanese cultural performances such as kuda lumping and fire shows along the course.

faqs.question: Who won the Surabaya Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: Robi Siyanturi won the men's full marathon. The race had open, national and masters divisions across the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km.
